issues.title: Touch Screen Inaccuracy
issues.body:
I’ve been running into an issue with my AYN Thor. The touch screen on the bottom is about 1cm off making typing impossible and games very difficult. This issue only happens in MelonDS, not when I’m on google or anything else for the AYN Thor. Is there any way to troubleshoot this or to calibrate my inputs?


Update: it seems to work normally if I turn the “keep DS aspect ratio” toggle off. So if I play in stretched mode the touch inputs are perfectly accurate but not in the DS’s normal aspect ratio.

issues.title: Close Lid when locking android screen
issues.body:
Considering the Samsung Z Flip and Z Fold can provide a more close to reality experience with their foldable screens, it would be nice if actually closing them would close the emulated DS lid.

Currently locking the screen pauses emulation, but it would be even nicer if emulation continued for a few seconds (with a wake_lock) in order for the game to trigger actions when the lid is closed, and then actually pause emulation.

Notable examples include Super Mario 64 DS which says "Buh Bye!" when closing the lid, and "It's-a me, Mario!" when opening it up.
issues.display_title: Close Lid when locking android screen

issues.title: Update melonDS version
issues.body:
The current version of melonDS (0.9.3) is outdated, the new one has at least one bug fixed that I experienced in the current version.
The bug happens randomly in Pokémon Black 2/White 2 while the C-Gear is activated and somehow corrupts the game state. The bug has to do with some wifi signal that is not handled correctly I think. It is very annoying when it happens because all your unsaved progress is pretty much lost.
